title: State v. Rios — inquiry rather than counteroffer
shortTitle: State v. Rios — inquiry rather than counteroffer
summary: An inquiry about a different proposed plea did not necessarily reject the offer already made.
notes: The appellate court reversed the contrary ruling and treated a later timely acceptance as effective, subject to court approval of the plea agreement. The entry concerns contract characterization of an inquiry. It does not adopt the passage’s collateral descriptions as a full account of criminal procedure.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 270–271. Open assigned page 270.
